basics.name: Luca Visciola
basics.label: Full Stack Developer & Technology Consultant
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer and Technology Consultant, building for the web since 2009 alongside startups, companies and agencies. A musician before I was a developer, and self-taught, which means every abstraction I use I had to take apart first. These days the through-line is sovereignty: software that runs on hardware you own, over data that never leaves it, in systems you are allowed to read all the way down.

references.name: What they say
references.reference: Eager to take every chance to learn more. Decisive, yet open in strategic vision. Comfortable when things get critical.
